title: Slovakian Meat Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Slovakia, made with tender meat and rich vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the Slovakian sausage and beef brisket, then set aside.
Add more oil if needed, then sauté the onions and carrots until tender.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes, red wine, and beef broth to the pot.
Return the browned meat to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer to the oven, cooking at 300°F for 2.5 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
